name: Discrete Transistor — 5V, 30V — SOP
description: Discrete surface-mount transistor cluster with 5V and 30V facets in SOP packaging, featuring single-channel NMOS part CJQ20N03 with SOP-8 footprint.
selection_hints: SMD layout requires a SOP package family or SOP-8 footprint.
Application aligns with 5V or 30V voltage facets.
Single-channel NMOS transistor CJQ20N03 is suitable.
Parts sourced from JLCPCB-Kicad-Library with tier B rating are acceptable.
avoid_when: Through-hole or non-SOP packaging is required on the PCB.
Operating parameters fall outside the 5V or 30V facets.
A p-channel or multi-channel transistor is needed instead of single-channel NMOS.
Tier A parts or alternative component libraries are mandatory.
